home.todayFocus: Today: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} of focus
home.noDiscoveries: Your first postcard is {minutes} focus minutes away.

timer.completedWhileAwayMinutes: Your {minutes}-minute session finished while you were away.

postcard.shareText: I collected a postcard from {city} on WANDERMIN ✈️

onboarding.title: Where does your journey begin?
onboarding.body: Every focused minute flies you 50 km. Pick a home airport to begin.
onboarding.step1: Focus, and you fly: every minute is 50 km.
onboarding.step2: Land in a real city and collect its postcard.
onboarding.step3: Your journal keeps every flight. Missed days cost nothing.
onboarding.pick: Pick a home airport to begin.

focus.cancelConfirm: Cancel this session? It won't count toward your trip.
focus.awayNote: Leaving the app is fine: time keeps counting and catches up when you return. With cabin sound on, the landing is usually recorded on time even with the screen off (this depends on the device).
focus.breakDone: Break over. Ready for the next flight?
focus.tooShort: Sessions under a minute aren't recorded.

journal.empty: Nothing here yet. Your first flight fills this page.

profile.departureLocked: Your journey started in {city}. The departure can't change once you've flown.
profile.dataBody: Everything is stored only on this device. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
profile.resetConfirm: Erase every session, postcard and pass? This can't be undone.
profile.importConfirm: Replace this device's travel log with the backup?
profile.importInvalid: That file isn't a WANDERMIN backup.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen: it opens full-screen, works offline and can show your flight on the lock screen.
pwa.iosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.installed: Installed. You're using the app version.
pwa.offline: Offline · your progress is saved on this device
pwa.iosKeep: In Safari, install to your home screen so your travel log is kept safely: Share → Add to Home Screen.

companion.cabinHint: Plays a soft in-flight hum. Your lock screen then shows the flight, the landing time and a progress bar, and you can pause from there.
companion.notifyHint: Shows your landing time as a notification while you focus.
companion.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or system settings.
companion.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work after installing the app to your home screen.
companion.title: Flying to {city}
companion.arrivedBody: A new postcard is waiting for you.

welcome.lead: Focus, and you fly between real cities. Every arrival leaves you a postcard.
welcome.how1: Each focused minute flies you {km} km. Pause anytime.
welcome.how2: Land in a real city and collect its pixel-art postcard.
welcome.how3: Every flight stays in your journal and on the map. Days off are fine.
welcome.private: No sign-up. Everything stays on this device.
welcome.fromBody: Your home airport. You can start over later in Profile.
welcome.toBody: Flight time = focus time. A short first flight gets you your first postcard sooner.
welcome.laterAnywhere: After this, you can fly to any of the 30 cities.
welcome.boardBody: {minutes} minutes of focus takes you to {city}.
welcome.nSessions: About {n} sessions of {minutes} minutes get you there — progress carries over.
welcome.awayOk: You can leave the app or lock the screen — time keeps counting.
